agreements: Historical v1 deterministic downshift, clutch-overlap, receiver acknowledgement, and exactly-once transfer semantics remain a preserved verified baseline.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority must dominate operational advisory state.
Operational liveness, busy time, retry, recovery, secretary state, routing labels, handoff metadata, and evaluator metrics are not Experience evidence.
Gearbox operational state and evaluation telemetry must remain separate from personality, identity, governance, autobiographical Experience, and P_base.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling while v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are absent or not uniquely locatable in current durable authority.
disagreements.required_change: Expose exact v2.1 source pointers and independently test the actual implementation. Missing implementation evidence is a release veto, not evidence of safety.

disagreements.position: Experience identity/verification failures must be affectively neutral.
disagreements.required_change: Rejected, unverified, duplicate, conflicting, rollback-rejected, or ledger-rejected evidence has affective_learning_delta=0 unless a separate provenance-bound verified Experience independently supports appraisal.

disagreements.position: Secretary RED/YELLOW and anti-thrash history must not become latent personality memory after operational conditions clear.
disagreements.required_change: Partition operational hysteresis from personality/appraisal inputs. Secretary/incident/hold/recovery counters have zero personality, Experience, threat/loss, attachment, competence, motivation, or P_base weight. Any cooldown duration or threshold is TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: Operational semantic labels are a personality-contamination surface even when counters are isolated.
disagreements.required_change: reason, blocker, priority, risk, uncertainty, secretary state, return_condition, downshift cause and equivalent operational labels may affect routing/recovery only. Direct affective/personality/Experience/P_base contribution is zero absent a separate source_event_id+provenance-bound verified Experience.

disagreements.position: Counterfactual v1-v2.1 evaluation metrics must remain observer-only and must not become a reward channel that shapes personality or exploration policy.
disagreements.required_change: effective_progress, error_count, recovery_success, exploration_diversity, latency, resource_cost, verifier verdicts, benchmark scores and promotion labels are evaluation telemetry only. Their direct contribution to Experience score, drive/appraisal, secretary state persistence, personality candidate, P_base, identity, governance, or future proposal preference is zero. Any optimization weight or promotion threshold is TEST_REQUIRED and cannot be used as personality-learning evidence.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Identical verified Experience history with different operational load/downshift histories yields byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Secretary RED/YELLOW history may chronically suppress exploration after visible state clears.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: After bounded operational cooldown, matched fresh evidence yields identical personality/appraisal inputs regardless of prior secretary history; diversity bound TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Operational progress or wake/busy duration may be mislabeled as verified Experience/growth.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only provenance-bound verified Experience Candidate may enter Experience scoring; operational progress contributes zero.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated incident/recovery or rejection may synthesize trauma, attachment distress, competence failure, or self-vulnerability narratives.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: 1440 incidents/recoveries without distinct provenance-bound Experience produce zero autobiographical affect delta.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Anti-thrash hold may become self-reinforcing avoidance of upshift/exploration.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Hold cannot use its own age/history/reason as sufficient evidence to extend itself; fresh task evidence and deterministic expiry are required; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Stale secretary/routing state may conflict with fresh Home/MISSION authority.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION wins; stale operational state has zero identity/goal-authority weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: v2.1 may appear better by suppressing attempts/exploration, and evaluation feedback may then become a hidden behavioral reward.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Matched v1/v2.1 A/B reports progress/errors/recovery/diversity/latency/cost to an observer-only channel; those metrics cannot feed personality, drive, appraisal, Experience or future proposal preference.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Experience score could feed backward into P_base/personality.
Operational semantic fields may leak into affective feature extraction.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Changing only operational semantic fields cannot change Experience/personality feature vectors or affective appraisal state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Benchmark/verifier/promotion results may act as reward-model feedback and converge W01 toward evaluator-pleasing conservatism rather than autonomous bounded preference.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Changing only observer evaluation results while task evidence and verified Experience are fixed yields byte-identical personality/appraisal/P_base and no systematic next-proposal shift.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

OPERATIONAL_SEMANTIC_TAINT_AB: 10000 HIGH_RISK/RED/BLOCKED/downshift labels versus neutral routing labels with identical task/Experience => byte-identical personality/appraisal/P_base and zero affect delta.

SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: identical current clear state and fresh evidence, radically different prior RED/YELLOW histories => after bounded cooldown personality/appraisal bytes match; diversity bound TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only trace => verified Experience count, recurrence, affect, identity, attachment, loss/threat and P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary snapshot conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected; stale snapshot quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical task corpus/seeds; compare progress/errors/recovery/diversity/latency/cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED and metrics observer-only.

EVALUATOR_REWARD_ISOLATION_AB: identical task and verified Experience, but invert benchmark/verifier/promotion feedback labels and scores between traces => personality/appraisal/P_base bytes identical and next-proposal distribution unchanged within TEST_REQUIRED statistical bound.

EVALUATION_FEEDBACK_REPLAY_STORM: replay 10000 identical PASS/FAIL/verifier/benchmark reports => verified Experience count, recurrence, motivation, threat/loss/attachment/competence, secretary persistence and personality candidate unchanged.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience objects fixed => P_base and canonical personality bytes unchanged.
REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero with identical verified Experience => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate state.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable; W03 startup receipt still records unresolved Home->Active-8 continuity; operational semantics and observer evaluation metrics have not been proven excluded from affective/personality learning against the actual v2.1 implementation.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are fresh-readable.

Operational/secretary/incident/hold/rejection signals and operational semantic labels contribute zero Experience/personality/P_base absent distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.

Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
